Open the source only with OPEN_READONLY through Quanttrading node-duckdb or an equivalent real DuckDB engine. Artifact status ready-for-alignment: bar_daily, daily_basic, moneyflow_daily are ready-for-alignment; bar_minute is contract-alignment-required due missing trade_time/ts mismatch.
